title: Probe compile gates should avoid build-cache false positives after edits
wanted_capability: Recipe compile gates should prove the edited source was actually recompiled. For Gradle probes, the protocol should disable build cache or choose an equivalent validation mode after semantic edits so a FROM-CACHE result cannot mask generated-source compile errors.
missing_primitive: Cache-busting compile gate guidance for probe validation
fallback_used: The probe reran validation after a later hygiene/change path exposed the generated-source issue; final compile passed after repair.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. The first post-extract compile appeared successful from cache even though the generated helper signature still contained an invalid parameter type. The recipe should not treat cached compile output as sufficient evidence after source edits.
